instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Curtain Wall Studio Front. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in Archicad. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements: Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, Stairs, Columns, Beams, or Curtain Walls where required. Do not use visual-only Morphs, objects, meshes, or generic proxy placeholders as substitutes for the required BIM elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. Start from the provided studio shell. Make a glazed front for the studio using either one real Curtain Wall element or at least four real Window elements across the front facade. Keep Zones named STUDIO, OFFICE, STORE, and WC with real walls, slab, doors, and remaining windows. The exported IFC must contain exactly 4 Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named STUDIO, OFFICE, STORE, WC. It must contain exactly 1 building storey; at least 8 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements; at least 1 IfcSlab element; at least 4 IfcDoor elements; either at least 1 IfcCurtainWall element or at least 4 IfcWindow elements on the glazed front. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 12 m, Y span 7 m, and Z span about 3.2 m. Keep the model simple enough to complete manually in Archicad: rectangular or orthogonal rooms, ordinary straight walls, standard door/window tools, simple slab and roof elements, and only the listed structural or glazed elements where requested. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects and should not contain IfcBuildingElementProxy objects as substitutes for required spaces, walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, columns, beams, or curtain walls. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content and approximate overall size.
